claims.note: A trainer's new return-date remark four weeks after his first interview joined the first interview's claim; both are estimates by the trainer, not an official date.
A third party defending the fighter on a talk show joined one rival's matchmaking claim, five days later and at low confidence.
The same fighter's callout in a second interview two weeks later joined the claim about his first one (question 2, one speaker repeating himself).
A former champion's comment on a different fighter joined a claim about the champion's own interview.
The fighter's written essay of the next day joined the claim about his video letter to his son; the essay carries the injury news that has its own claim.
The fighter's post-fight interview stubs and next-opponent analysis joined the claim about his win.
